releaseNotes:
_Date: 2026-05-05_

---

### ✨ What's New

#### 🎙 Voice Interaction — Realtime & Fallback Pipelines
Compass Partner now ships with a **full voice layer** for hands-free conversations with your agent.

- **Realtime voice sessions** — a WebRTC-based broker negotiates a live audio session with the Compass backend. Voice controls appear in the chat input footer when you're in ACP mode, with a compact layout that keeps the interface tidy.
- **Fallback voice pipeline** — when the realtime endpoint is unavailable, the app automatically switches to a VAD → STT → ACP → TTS pipeline. Audio is segmented locally using `@ricky0123/vad-web`, transcribed via the Compass API, routed through your active ACP session, and the reply can be synthesised back to speech. The mode switch is seamless and recovery to realtime is automatic.
- **Push-to-talk fallback** — if VAD initialisation fails, the app gracefully falls back to push-to-talk mode.
- **Voice Mode badge** in Settings shows current state (realtime / fallback / unavailable) and the last probe timestamp so you always know what's happening under the hood.

#### 🤖 Remote Agent Management & A2A Client
Full end-to-end support for connecting to and chatting with **remote A2A agents** is now available:

- **Remote Agents settings panel** — add, edit, and remove remote agent endpoints with a dedicated form dialog. Credentials are stored securely in the OS keychain.
- **Unified chat creation dialog** — when starting a new chat you can now choose between Local, Remote, or Smart Setup modes from a single dialog.
- **Agent health monitoring** — a new `AgentHealthService` probes all remote agents and surfaces their status with an `AgentHealthDot` indicator. The panel refreshes automatically on load — no manual refresh button needed.
- **Offline state in chat** — when a remote agent is unreachable, the chat input is disabled and a clear offline banner is shown, preventing you from sending messages into the void.

#### 🏠 Hosted Agent Inspector
A new **Hosted Agent panel** in Settings lets you inspect the locally-hosted A2A Nova agent in real time:

- Live session list with status, duration, and turn counts
- Conversation transcript drawer — click any session to read the full exchange
- Session termination with a two-step destructive confirm (arm → confirm within 3 s) and optimistic removal
- On-demand **OpenAPI 3.0 spec** generation for the admin REST API (Postman-ready)

#### 🛡 Device Authorization Matrix
Device pairing now goes through a **formal authorization flow**:

- A visual `DeviceMatrix` component shows the approval/revoke status of every paired device.
- A pre-pairing **eligibility gate** checks whether the device can be paired before initiating the request, preventing incomplete pairing states.
- Revoke operations are now **fault-tolerant** — local cleanup always runs in `finally`, even when the remote call fails, and the result is returned as a structured `A2aPairingRevokeResult`.
- **Startup reconciliation** re-syncs pairing state on launch and replays events to the renderer so the UI is always consistent.

#### 🧙 Smart Setup Wizard
A new **Smart Setup** mode in the chat creation dialog lets you describe your intent in plain language and get tailored Nova recommendations:

- Nova is invoked non-interactively to suggest relevant marketplace skills and MCP tools.
- A review step lets you inspect, toggle, and confirm each recommended item before installation.
- Server-side validation filters out hallucinated IDs; a nonce cache prevents replay attacks.
- Supports both project-scoped and global MCP tool installation.

#### 📅 Enterprise Scheduler
The built-in scheduler has been significantly upgraded:

- **Cron parsing & natural language schedules** — `ScheduleParser` handles both standard cron expressions and human-readable schedules (e.g. "every weekday at 9 am").
- **Pause / Resume** — individual tasks can be paused and resumed without losing history.
- **Grouped execution history** — history is now organised by folder and task, with executions collapsed by default for a cleaner view.
- **Human-readable cron display** — the cron expression is always shown in plain English alongside the raw schedule.
- **Hosted agent scheduling** — you can attach a hosted A2A agent to a scheduled task directly from the Hosted Agent panel.

#### 🛒 Marketplace: MCP Servers & Directory Pointers
The Marketplace backend now supports **MCP server entries** and **directory-pointer skills/agents**, expanding what can be discovered and installed beyond single-file skills.

---

### 🛠 Improvements

- **Unified Agents tab** — the Remote and Hosted Agent sections have been merged from two separate tabs into a single **Agents** tab in Settings, with a vertical split layout for a more coherent view.
- **Extensions tab** — the Marketplace tab in Settings has been renamed to **Extensions** for clearer semantics; labels and tab ordering have been updated throughout.
- **Playwright CLI tool** — a built-in Playwright tool definition is now available out of the box for browser automation workflows.
- **Interactive empty-state chips** — the chat empty state now shows suggestion chips that are fully interactive prompts, not just decorative placeholders.
- **Collapsed sidebar controls** — workspace and assistant buttons are now hidden when the sidebar is collapsed, reducing visual clutter.
- **Alphabetical model list** — models in the ModelSwitcher are sorted alphabetically for faster scanning.
- **Portal connection always approved** — the portal connection approval flow has been streamlined; the connection is always considered approved, eliminating a friction point.
- **ACP global tool sync** — enabling or disabling a global tool now propagates to the active ACP session automatically via a debounced reconnect, eliminating the need to manually toggle ACP off and on.
- **CLI update from Setup Wizard** — if a newer CLI version is available, an update button appears in the CLI ready state of the setup wizard, with version comparison info and differentiated error messages.
- **LRU memory eviction & stale-session cleanup** — the Zustand chat store now enforces an LRU cap on cached messages and purges stale sessions to keep memory usage bounded.
- **Knowledge upload queue** — file uploads in the Knowledge panel are now processed sequentially with a per-file queue, preventing race conditions when uploading multiple files.
- **Premium design system** — a cohesive enterprise design language has been rolled out across marketplace, layout components, and the scheduler UI.

---

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

- Fixed the taskbar/dock icon using the wrong logo — Compass branding now appears correctly on all platforms.
- Fixed Settings tabs reordering and label inconsistencies (Extensions rename, Workspace section rename, Add Agent button wrapping).
- Fixed MCP gallery badge clipping on tool cards.
- Fixed Marketplace sort order — Compass AI is now always pinned first; remaining entries are sorted alphabetically, and autofocus is suppressed on open.
- Fixed Knowledge panel background colour to match other enterprise panels.
- Fixed A2A duplicate `get()` method that caused a TypeScript compilation error.
- Fixed Google Stitch favicon URL in the Compass service.
- Fixed scheduler execution history expanding by default — entries now start collapsed.

---

### ⚙️ Under the Hood

- **Electron 28 → 41.1.0** — major Electron upgrade bringing the latest Chromium, Node.js, and security patches.
- **better-sqlite3 9 → 12.9.0** — keeps the embedded database driver in sync with the new Electron ABI.
- **uuid ^9 → ^14** — updated UUID generation library; `@types/uuid` dependency dropped (types now bundled).
- **WhatsApp sandboxed to utility process** — Baileys is now run inside an Electron utility process, isolating its native modules and `protobufjs ^7.5.5` from the main process.
- **Hardened Content Security Policy** — CSP now includes `wasm-unsafe-eval`, `blob:` media sources, and the OpenAI API origin; the Electron mirror override has been removed.
- **Attachment store refactor** — the chat store's attachment input now uses a plain data object instead of a `File` reference, making it serialisable across the IPC boundary.
- **Shared `humanizeCron` utility** — cron humanisation logic is now shared between the scheduler history and task list views, eliminating duplication.
